meta.name: meta-tags-optimizer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "optimize meta tags"; improves titles, descriptions, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and CTR test variants. Not for JSON-LD structured data — use schema-markup-generator; not for body copy — use seo-content-writer. 标题优化/元描述/CTR

copy.tagline: 优化网页标题和描述以提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要改善网页在搜索结果中的表现
copy.tagline_en: Optimize page titles and descriptions to boost click-through rates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve your web pages' performance in search results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你优化网页的标题、描述、Open Graph 和 Twitter 卡片等元标签，生成多个版本并检查对齐，最后给出点击率优化建议。
howto.when: 当你要求“优化元标签”或“改善标题/描述”时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面的元标签：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并生成优化方案。

say.text: 为关于“健康饮食”的文章写三个标题和描述
say.note: Claude 会生成多个选项供你选择。

say.text: 改善这些元标签的点击率：[当前标签]
say.note: Claude 会分析并提供优化建议。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude optimizes title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph, and Twitter Cards for a page, generates multiple variants, checks alignment, and provides CTR optimization tips.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'optimize meta tags' or 'improve titles/descriptions'.

say_en.text: Optimize meta tags for this page: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and generates optimized tags.

say_en.text: Write three titles and descriptions for an article about 'healthy eating'
Improve CTR for these meta tags: [current tags]
